name: Sh[in]e
source:
One day, Lillie awakens in an unknown bed next to Sol, a man she's never seen. He also doesn't know how she got there, but he assures her that it is his bed and bedroom, and that she wasn't there the night before. She doesn't remember anything, nor carries anything on her... not even clothes.
The boy's stepmother, a woman too keen on social standing, bursts into the bedroom, misunderstanding everything, and he lies by claiming that Lillie's his betrothed, since he is sick of his stepmother looking for a wife for him.

The protagonist and Sol decide to fake their relationship and live together, at least until she gets her memories back.

[translated from [url=http://strawberry-traducciones.blogspot.com.ar/p/shine.html]Strawberry Translations[/url]]
translation:
有一天，莉莉在一张不知名的床上醒来，旁边是索尔，一个她从未见过的男人。他也不知道她是怎么到那里的，但他向她保证那是他的床和卧室，而且前一天晚上她并不在那儿。她什么都不记得了，身上也没有带任何东西……甚至连衣服都没有。
男孩的继母，一个太注重社会地位的女人，冲进卧室，误解了一切，他撒谎说莉莉是他的未婚夫，因为他厌倦了继母为他寻找妻子。

主角和索尔决定假装他们的关系并住在一起，至少直到她恢复记忆为止。

[译自[url=http://strawberry-traducciones.blogspot.com.ar/p/shine.html]Strawberry Translations[/url]]
